requirement: Undoing a chat turn asks first inside the card, runs one undo at a time per chat, reads the chat fresh before offering Undo, counts only a verified undo as done, and keeps undos of unknown outcome apart from refusals

oracle.ref: PR #829 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #802: one press on Undo all sent one apply.revert per change with no question, and refusals were shown as a count only; a 200 with an unreadable body counted as reverted. Since feat/undo-turn-card (06/10/2026) the per-turn card replaces the Undo all card and the reverts run on the server; this case keeps the same fences on the new path.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'Cancel sends nothing and goes back to the card' passes: 0 POSTs to /api/sites/<key>/turns/undo. 'Undo asks inside the card, sends one POST for the latest turn, re-reads, reloads the preview, then shows Undone' passes. 'in flight: a second confirm starts no second POST, and no other card of the chat can start an undo' passes: exactly one POST. 'a card shown for another chat, or back to one, draws no Undo until a fresh read of that chat answered' passes. 'outcomes: done, partial, refused with its code, and every kind of silence as unsure' passes: a 2xx that is not a turns-undo answer, a 5xx with no answer and a thrown fetch are unsure, never refused. 'a refusal leaves a line and reloads no preview' passes. In apps/tracy-web/test/turn-undo.test.mjs every test passes, including the ones on revertOutcome (only {ok: true} from apply.revert is a revert; COMPONENT_UNREACHABLE and COMPONENT_BAD_RESPONSE are unsure) and on runUndo stopping at the first step that did not verifiably succeed.
